# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 064

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1575–1599, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. I corrected seven Hindi entries whose examples or glosses retained distracting English fragments or expressed the meaning too awkwardly: `direct`, `clearly`, `wide`, `below`, `sorry`, `nearly`, and `capital`. The other 18 senses in this batch were semantically aligned.

Changed: 7 Hindi gloss/example pairs. Refreshed source fingerprints for the 25 reviewed senses in the locale status files.

Progress: 1,600/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (18.11%); 7,237 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
